then.text: Another successful survey! The kettle's on. The kettle is always on. That's the only rule.
Take your pipit to the scientist at King Edward Point. She'll be thrilled. She cries at birds.
That's a Tussipit all right! The world's southernmost songbird, back from the brink. Now take it to the scientist at King Edward Point and make her day.

else.text: Look in the tussac grass at Grytviken or here on the plain. Listen for a tiny song among the shouting. Snares are in your bag.
This hut sees ten thousand penguin-hours a year, and four ranger-hours of sleep. I'm counting birds.

Want a job? We need someone to find a South Georgia pipit. The rats nearly wiped them out. Now the island's rat-free and they're coming back. Find a Tussipit, catch it, and show it to the scientist at King Edward Point.
